description: Retrieves a paginated list of posts that reference (link back to) the specified post. Archived posts and WIP posts are excluded. Results are ordered by backlink registration date (newest references first).

postNumber.description: The post number to get backlinks for

teamName.description: Team name (required). Use esa_get_teams first to see available teams.

name: esa_get_post_backlinks
title: Get backlinks for a specific post
